items.quote: A Setsys Evolution dilatometer (from Setaram Instrumentation) was employed in measuring the r   l + (Mo) transformation temperature for an Fe-85.9 mol% Mo alloy.

The pyrometer (from Mikron Inc.USA, Model M390) employed to record the cooling curve in the present study is a radiation pyrometer that works on the principle of black body radiation and is based on Planck's Law.
Tie-line measurements were carried out using the EPMA (from JEOL Ltd., Model JXA-8530F).

In essence, the experiment consists of dropping of sample of mass nearly 80-90 mg kept at a fixed reference temperature ðT ref 1⁄4 298 KÞ on to a pure alumina bed, well-equilibrated and maintained at a desired experimental temperature (T) to within  0.1.

items.instrument: Multi HTC-96 drop calorimeter (from Setaram Instrumentation)
items.quote: A Multi HTC-96 drop calorimeter (from Setaram Instrumentation) was employed for gathering enthalpy increment data ðHT   H298 Þ in the two-phase region comprising of ðl þ ðMoÞÞ for an Fe-73.74 mol% Mo alloy as a function of temperature using inverse drop calorimetry principle.
Alloys were prepared by arc melting of high purity iron (99.99%) filings and molybdenum (99.95%) wire (from Alfa Aesar) in argon atmosphere.
